title: Jack's Perfect Murder Failed Because The Woman Lied About Her Name . . . (Episode 7)
caption:
In Death Note episode 7, Jack writes Naomi's name in the Death Note and nothing happens, because the name she gave him was fake.
So he lies his way into the task force story, until she hands over her real driver's license. Follow for episode 8!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Would you have trusted Jack with your real name, or stayed careful like Naomi? Why?

segments.say: Jack checks his watch, and the woman in front of him walks off to *die*.
To see how it got here, go back to the moment Jack decides she *must* die.
Naomi knows how Kira kills, and she is walking straight to the *police*.
If she gets there, every clue leads straight back to *Jack*.
So he plays along and asks if she has told anyone *else*.
She says he is the first person she has told. Bad *move*.
Then he asks for the exact date and time of the bus *hijacking*.
He writes it on a page of the Death Note, with *suicide* as the cause.
She will end it alone, where nobody will ever find her *body*.
Suddenly Ryuk starts laughing, and Jack asks what is so *funny*.
Meanwhile, L tells the five detectives that Kira is not among *them*.
He set traps to catch Kira, but talking to each man was *enough*.
Then he takes a call and tells everyone to turn their phones *off*.
Outside, Jack stares at his watch and counts the *seconds*.
Then he whispers, hurry to your *death*.
But the woman just keeps walking like nothing is *wrong*.
Jack stares at her. Nothing happens. She does not even *flinch*.
He wrote the cause, he wrote the name, and she is still *alive*.
Then an old man named Watari arrives with a box of fake police *badges*.
Back outside, Jack finally gets it. The name she gave him was *fake*.
Ryuk saw her real name over her head the whole time. That is why he kept *laughing*.
She lied because Ray died right after he showed his *ID*.
Now she is walking to the police, and Jack cannot ask for her name without looking *suspicious*.
That was his first real *problem*.
He even promised to let her talk to his father, so he turns his phone *off*.
Then he thinks about her purse, her pockets, even using *force*.
But a crowded street is no place for that. He needs a better *plan*.
Ryuk offers the eye deal again, half his life for her real name, and Jack says *no*.
So he stops her and asks if she still wants to see the police. She says she would rather go *alone*.
Meanwhile, the detectives ask L why their police IDs carry fake *names*.
The answer is simple. Kira needs a name and a face to kill, so they get *fake* ones.
Then L hands out belts with transmitters hidden in the *buckles*.
Press the buckle twice, and Watari's phone shows who is calling.
The youngest detective loves it. He feels like a secret *agent*.
Back outside, Naomi thanks Jack and walks *away*.
He has five minutes before she reaches police headquarters. Then it is *over*.
So he runs after her and makes up a *story*.
He tells her she cannot reach the task force directly, because its members are *hidden*.
Nobody knows who is in charge, so nobody can end up like her *fiancé*.
Naomi is sharp. She asks how he knows so *much*.
So Jack says he is a member of the task *force*.
He is only a student, but L trusts him and lets him investigate *freely*.
She still wants to talk to L himself, and Jack cannot stop her.
Then she says she was an FBI agent who once worked under *L*.
Jack hears that and sees his *chance*.
She trusts nobody but L, and she tells Jack he reminds her of *him*.
That was her biggest *mistake*.
Jack takes that as a compliment. Then he asks her to join the task *force*.
He says he will recommend her, and she calls it *fate*.
Ray is gone. She has nothing left to lose, and she wants to catch *Kira*.
Jack nods like a good friend. Inside, he is *celebrating*.
Then he asks for some ID, and she admits her name was *fake*.
He forgives her right away, and she hands over a driver's *license*.
Jack reads the card at last. Her real name is Naomi *Misora*.
He smiles. He made it in *time*.
Naomi notices him checking his watch, and she asks *why*.
She has no idea she is talking to *Kira*.
Then her face changes. Something is *wrong*.
She says there is something she has to do, and she walks *off*.
Jack says goodbye, and this time he uses her real *name*.
She walks away through the snow, and she never *comes back*.
Jack still has his notebook, his grades, and his *secret*.
But L is already closing in, and Jack has no idea how *close*. Follow for episode 8!
